title: Doozy Vape Co Big Drip Watermelon Chill Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: As if the juicy, mellow sweetness of watermelon wasn’t enough to make this an utterly refreshing and tasty eliquid, Big Drip go and layer it with a gentle touch of menthol to deliver a sublime, cool vape bursting with flavour. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
